mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth rate over two consecutive quarters indicates strengthening economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP growth rate increases, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals a supply-side contraction, which leads to reduced corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 over a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), it indicates a real tightening of monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) is positive and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% over two months, it signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 0 and HOUST increases > 5% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
